text:
alex: quick heads-up — our onboarding demo started charging against org credentials after we rotated a service-scoped key. repro steps below.

alex: repro: set RW_API_KEY_SERVICE, start demo, rotate service key in console, later requests used REDWOOD_API_KEY (org) instead of the new service key.

nina: saw this in CI too. looks like the SDK picks REDWOOD_API_KEY when a rotate happens and the in-memory loader re-evaluates envs. logs: `auth: envs=[REDWOOD_API_KEY,RW_API_KEY_SERVICE] chosen=REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

phil: minimal repro:```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="org-9999"
export RW_API_KEY_SERVICE="svc-1234"
node demo/server.js
# after rotation headers show org-9999
```

kevin: another failure mode: long polling polling-client keeps its Authorization header and never asks tokenProvider for a refreshed token. when the service key is rotated we get 401s and the SDK doesn't attempt to refresh — it just surfaces the 401 to user callbacks.

phil: proposal: 1) explicit env precedence: RW_API_KEY_PROJECT > RW_API_KEY_SERVICE > RW_API_KEY_ORG > REDWOOD_API_KEY; 2) startup diag `auth.selected=RW_API_KEY_SERVICE (****1234)`; 3) emit WARN if REDWOOD_API_KEY and any RW_API_KEY_* coexist.

nina: +1. for long-poll/stream clients: on 401, call tokenProvider.refresh() (if provided) once, swap header, retry the last request/frame. If still 401, emit `auth:rotation_failed` event with reason and do not loop.

alex: also add a lightweight telemetry ping (anonymized) when conflicts are detected so we can measure impact. opt-out via `RW_AUTH_TELEMETRY=false`.

kevin: API surface: expose `auth.onRotationFailure((meta) => {})` and `auth.tokenProvider.refresh()` in SDK. default RW_ENABLE_TOKEN_REFRESH=true. keep RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true for a single release for safety.

phil: tests: small unit matrix for env permutations, integration that rotates service key while a long-poll client is connected and asserts either resumed calls or rotation_failed event.

sdk-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1682 "sdk: env precedence + service-key rotation + stream refresh behavior"

nina: I'll open a PR to restore precedence order and add the startup diag + warn. alex: can you update onboarding guide recommending clearing REDWOOD_API_KEY when using scoped keys?

alex: yep, will add a note and a one-liner to the quickstart. also add a small troubleshooting blurb about rotation and live features.

kevin: I'll prototype token refresh patch and add an example in the demo showing graceful reconnection.

phil: tiny UX thought — prefer suffix `RW_API_KEY_SERVICE` rather than `SERVICE_API_KEY` so all SDK envs live under RW_API_KEY_* namespace.

nina: agree. we'll document the precedence and provide `auth.precedence` override for internal infra use.

alex: thanks everyone. prioritize the warning + diag so we catch new onboards, then follow with stream refresh. closing thread for now; reopen if we see additional regressions. :white_check_mark:
